assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these symptoms.
The condition is coded as atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The service is medically necessary to identify an arrhythmia responsible for the palpitations and dyspnea in a patient with established coronary artery disease and cerebrovascular history.
